svg.title: Print operator — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as print operator, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A broad printing roller feeds a separate sheet bearing two clear printed lines. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a softly squared face.
